Scenario: Identity, recovery, and partner account linking
Business_risk: Duplicate or incorrectly linked accounts, unsafe recovery, or partner login granting disabled access

Scenario: Profiles, role context, and tenant permissions
Business_risk: Role labels grant unintended privilege; organization or tenant context exposes someone else’s records

Scenario: Discovery, offerings, and enrollment
Business_risk: Learners enroll without understanding terms, into inaccessible or obsolete versions, or more than once

Scenario: Learning, progress, and blended cohorts
Business_risk: Progress lost or forged; client completion bypasses required evidence; cohort facilitation exceeds scope

Scenario: Practical responsible AI learning and judgment
Business_risk: Polished AI output masks missing verification, confidential input, fabricated sources or unsafe judgment

Scenario: Assessment submission, scoring, and reviewer decisions
Business_risk: Invalid evidence, score boundaries, conflicting reviews or retries produce unreliable competence decisions

Scenario: Appeals and superseding decisions
Business_risk: Appeal semantics are reversed, history overwritten or credential eligibility races with superseding review

Scenario: Credential issue, verification, lifecycle, and privacy
Business_risk: Unqualified or duplicate awards; public verification discloses private evidence; stale revocation/expiry appears valid

Scenario: Cohort communities and moderation
Business_risk: Nonmembers read private discussions; misleading content lacks accountable moderation; peer advice appears approved

Scenario: Content publishing and delegated administration
Business_risk: Unreviewed or conflicting publication, unauthorized admin action or changed standards affect active learners

Scenario: Partner authorization, linking, enrollment and achievements
Business_risk: Partner identity, scope, links or endpoint authorization leaks data or accesses an internal network

Scenario: Outbox, webhook signatures, consent and replay
Business_risk: Nonatomic events, duplicates, bad signatures, stale permissions or replay make partner status unsafe

Scenario: Privacy, reporting, export, and learner support
Business_risk: Reports, exports, support or logs disclose private records or misrepresent learning outcomes

Scenario: Inclusive responsive and multilingual journeys
Business_risk: Supported learners cannot complete mandatory journeys because of language, device or accessibility barriers

Scenario: Performance, resilience, and platform security
Business_risk: Pilot load, interrupted transactions, failed workers, unsafe requests or restore cause loss or unavailable service

Scenario: R2 diagnostic recommendations and continuous learning
Business_risk: Future diagnostics/recommendations block access or infer competence; refreshers falsely renew credentials

Scenario: R2 live delivery, offline packages, mentors, and networking
Business_risk: Future sessions/offline resources/mentoring/networking expose identity or misrepresent access and expertise

Scenario: R2 commerce before any paid launch
Business_risk: Future payment or sponsor controls grant incorrect access or influence assessment standards

Scenario: R3 embedded AI assistant readiness
Business_risk: Embedded assistant is introduced before approved privacy, quality, escalation, cost and executable evaluations

Scenario: R1 eligibility deadlines and data-boundary hardening
Business_risk: Eligibility, invitations, deadlines or restored data bypass business rules; DNS rebinding or stale review permissions breach boundaries

Scenario: R2 trustworthy pricing and payment reconciliation
Business_risk: Future catalog changes, amount mismatches or timeouts cause incorrect entitlements or repeat charges
